name: syntive
description: Syntive — Zero-knowledge E2E encrypted bookmark sync extension & modern new-tab dashboard for Chromium and Firefox.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n ext,api -c blue,green "bun run dev:ext" "bun run dev:api"
scripts.build:ext: bun run --filter syntive-extension build && bun run --filter syntive-extension build:firefox
scripts.zip:ext: bun run --filter syntive-extension zip && bun run --filter syntive-extension zip:firefox
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter syntive-extension typecheck && bun run --filter syntive-backend typecheck
